قال تعالى:
 (اللهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا) [سورة الطلاق: ١٢].
قال تعالى:
 (إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ ۗ أَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ ۗ تَبَارَكَ اللهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ) [سورة الأعراف: ٥٤].

chapters.intro_en_source:
Allah Most High said:
 “Allah is the One who created seven heavens and of the earth the like of them. The command descends among them so that you may know that Allah is over all things powerful and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.” [al-Talaq: 12]
Allah Most High said:
 “Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then rose over the Throne. He covers the night with the day, which pursues it swiftly; and the sun, the moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Surely, to Him belong creation and command. Blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds.” [al-A‘raf: 54]

chapters.intro_ar_source:
قال تعالى:
 (وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ) [سورة الملك: ٥].
وقال تعالى:
 (وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ النُّجُومَ لِتَهْتَدُوا بِهَا فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ ۗ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا الْآيَاتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ) [سورة الأنعام: ٩٧].
وقال تعالى:
 (وَعَلَامَاتٍ ۚ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ) [سورة النحل: ١٦].
قال قتادة: “خلق الله عز وجل هذه النجوم لثلاث: جعلها زينة للسماء، ورجومًا للشياطين، وعلامات يُهتدى بها، فمن تأول فيها بغير ذلك أخطأ وأضاع نصيبه، وتكلف ما لا علم له به”.
 ذكره البخاري معلقًا في بدء الخلق، باب في النجوم. ووصله الطبري في تفسيره (٢٣/١٢٣) بإسناد صحيح عن بشر، عن يزيد، عن سعيد، عن قتادة فذكره.
 وبشر: هو ابن معاذ، ويزيد: هو ابن زريع، وسعيد: هو ابن أبي عروبة.

chapters.intro_en_source:
Allah Most High said:
 “And We have certainly adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and made them missiles for the devils, and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.” [al-Mulk: 5]
And Allah Most High said:
 “And He is the One who made the stars for you so that you may be guided by them through the darknesses of land and sea. We have detailed the signs for a people who know.” [al-An‘am: 97]
And Allah Most High said:
 “And landmarks; and by the stars they are guided.” [al-Nahl: 16]
Qatadah said: “Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created these stars for three purposes: He made them an adornment for the sky, missiles against the devils, and signs by which guidance is sought. Whoever interprets them in any way other than that has erred, wasted his share, and burdened himself with what he has no knowledge of.”
 Al-Bukhari mentioned it in suspended form in the Book of the Beginning of Creation, in the chapter concerning the stars. Al-Tabari connected it in his Tafsir (23/123) with an authentic chain from Bishr, from Yazid, from Sa‘id, from Qatadah, who mentioned it.
 Bishr is Ibn Mu‘adh, Yazid is Ibn Zuray‘, and Sa‘id is Ibn Abi ‘Arubah.

chapters.intro_ar_source:
قال الله تعالى:
 (وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ) [الأنبياء: ٣٣].
وقال تعالى:
 (وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ) [يس: ٣٨].
وقال تعالى:
 (وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ ۚ لَا تَسْجُدُوا لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ) [فصلت: ٣٧].

chapters.intro_en_source:
Allah Most High said:
 “And He is the One who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each is swimming in an orbit.” [al-Anbiya’: 33]
And Allah Most High said:
 “And the sun runs to its appointed resting place. That is the decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.” [Ya-Sin: 38]
And Allah Most High said:
 “And among His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostrate to Allah who created them, if it is Him that you worship.” [Fussilat: 37]

chapters.title_ar: ٩- باب أن الشمس والقمر آيتان من آيات الله، خلقهما الله لحكم عظيمة
chapters.title_en: 9 — Chapter: The Sun and the Moon Are Two Signs from the Signs of Allah; Allah Created Them for Great Wisdoms

chapters.intro_ar_source:
قال الله تعالى:
 (وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا) [سورة الفرقان: ٤٨].
وقال تعالى:
 (يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا) [الأحزاب: ٩].
وقال تعالى:
 (وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَن يُرْسِلَ الرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَاتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَلِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ) [الروم: ٤٦].
وقال تعالى:
 (وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ) [الحاقة: ٦].

chapters.intro_en_source:
Allah Most High said:
 “And He is the One who sends the winds as glad tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water.” [al-Furqan: 48]
And Allah Most High said:
 “O you who believe, remember Allah’s favor upon you when armies came against you, and We sent against them a wind and armies you did not see. And Allah was Seeing of what you were doing.” [al-Ahzab: 9]
And Allah Most High said:
 “And among His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of glad tidings, and so that He may let you taste of His mercy, and so that the ships may sail by His command, and so that you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you may be grateful.” [al-Rum: 46]
And Allah Most High said:
 “And as for ‘Ad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind.” [al-Haqqah: 6]

 (إِنَّهُ يَرَاكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيلُهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْ) [سورة الأعراف: ٢٧]، إلا إذا تشكلوا بأشكال المخلوقين كما سيأتي.

chapters.intro_en_source:
The world of the jinn is an independent world of its own, not to be measured by the world of human beings. They were called “jinn” because they are hidden from human sight, though they see us while we do not see them. Allah Most High said:
 “Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe, from where you do not see them.” [al-A‘raf: 27]
 This is except when they take the forms of created beings, as will come.

جاء في التنزيل:
 (قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ وَإِنِّي عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٌ) [سورة النمل: ٣٩].
والعفريت معناه: القوي الشديد.
 ولكن الله جعل الذي عنده علم من الكتاب أقدر منه، كما جاء في التنزيل:
 (قَالَ الَّذِي عِندَهُ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ) [سورة النمل: ٤٠].
 يقال: إنه جبريل، فإنه يعلم اسم الله الأعظم الذي إذا دُعي به أجاب، وإذا سُئل به أعطى، وقيل غير ذلك، والذي ذكرتُه هو أصحها.

It occurs in the Revelation:
 “A powerful one from among the jinn said: I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed I am strong and trustworthy for it.” [al-Naml: 39]
“‘Ifrit” means one who is very strong.
 But Allah made the one who had knowledge from the Book more capable than him, as occurs in the Revelation:
 “The one who had knowledge from the Book said: I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.” [al-Naml: 40]
 It is said that he was Jibril, for he knows the greatest name of Allah, by which, when He is called, He answers, and by which, when He is asked, He gives. Other views have also been stated, but what I have mentioned is the soundest of them.

chapters.intro_ar_source:
قال الله تعالى حكاية عن الجن:
 (وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا) [سورة الجن: ١١].
 أي: منا المسلمون، ومنا الكافرون والفساق.
 “قِدَدًا” من القِدّة، وهي القطعة من الشيء. يقال: صار القوم قِددًا إذا اختلفت حالاتهم. والمعنى: نحن الجن جماعات متفرقون، وأصناف مختلفة.
وقالوا أيضًا:
 (وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا ۝ وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا) [الجن: ١٤-١٥].
 والقاسطون: الجائرون، العادلون عن الحق، وهم الكفار.

chapters.intro_en_source:
Allah Most High said, narrating from the jinn:
 “And among us are the righteous, and among us are other than that; we were divided into different ways.” [al-Jinn: 11]
 Meaning: among us are Muslims, and among us are disbelievers and sinners.
 “Qidadā” comes from “qiddah,” meaning a piece of something. It is said: “The people became qidadā” when their conditions differed. The meaning is: We jinn are separate groups and different types.
They also said:
 “And among us are Muslims, and among us are the unjust. Whoever accepts Islam, those have sought right guidance. As for the unjust, they will be firewood for Hell.” [al-Jinn: 14–15]
 “The unjust” are those who deviate from the truth; they are the disbelievers.

chapters.intro_en_source:
Allah Most High said:
 “When your Lord said to the angels: Indeed, I am creating a human being from clay. So when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down to him in prostration. He said: O Iblis, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My two hands? Were you arrogant, or were you among the exalted? He said: I am better than him. You created me from fire, and You created him from clay.” [Sad: 71–76]

Allah Most High said:
 “When your Lord said to the angels: Indeed, I am creating a human being from clay. So when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down to him in prostration. So the angels all prostrated, all together, except Iblis; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers. He said: O Iblis, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My two hands? Were you arrogant, or were you among the exalted? He said: I am better than him. You created me from fire, and You created him from clay.” [Sad: 71–76]

chapters.intro_ar_source:
قال الله تعالى:
 (وَاللهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِّن مَّاءٍ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ أَرْبَعٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُ اللهُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ) [النور: ٤٥].
وقال تعالى:
 (وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَابَّةٍ آيَاتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ) [الجاثية: ٤].
وقال تعالى:
 (خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝ وَالْأَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ ۝ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ ۝ وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا بَالِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ الْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ ۝ وَالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ) [النحل: ٤-٨].

chapters.intro_en_source:
Allah Most High said:
 “And Allah created every moving creature from water. Among them are those that move upon their bellies, among them are those that walk upon two legs, and among them are those that walk upon four. Allah creates what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things powerful.” [al-Nur: 45]
And Allah Most High said:
 “And in your creation and in what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for a people who are certain.” [al-Jathiyah: 4]
And Allah Most High said:
 “He created the human being from a drop, then behold, he is an open disputant. And livestock He created for you; in them is warmth and benefits, and from them you eat. And for you in them is beauty when you bring them home in the evening and when you send them out to pasture. And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with hardship to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful. And horses, mules, and donkeys, for you to ride and as adornment; and He creates what you do not know.” [al-Nahl: 4–8]
